questions.question: Docker Compose nima va qachon ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Ko'p container'li ilovani bitta YAML (compose.yaml) da e'lon qilib, bitta buyruq bilan ko'tarish vositasi. Lokal dev, test, kichik single-host deploy uchun.

questions.question: Compose'da service'lar bir-biriga qanday ulanadi?
questions.explanation: Compose loyiha uchun default network yaratadi; har service nomi DNS hostname bo'ladi (db:5432). Container ichida localhost — o'sha container'ning o'zi.

questions.question: `docker compose down` va `down -v` farqi? Ma'lumot qachon yo'qoladi?
questions.explanation: down — container va network'ni o'chiradi, named volume qoladi. down -v named volume'larni ham o'chiradi — DB ma'lumoti yo'qoladi.

questions.question: `depends_on` service tayyor bo'lishini kafolatlaydimi?
questions.explanation: Default faqat ishga tushish tartibini (container start). Tayyorlikni kutish uchun healthcheck + condition: service_healthy kerak; ilova baribir retry qilishi lozim.

questions.question: Compose'da environment: `.env`, `env_file`, `environment` va o'zgaruvchi interpolatsiyasi farqi?
questions.explanation: `.env` (loyiha papkasida) — compose.yaml ichidagi ${VAR} interpolatsiyasi uchun; env_file — container'ga o'zgaruvchilar yuklaydi; environment — inline, ustunroq.

questions.question: Dev va prod uchun turli Compose konfiguratsiya: override, profiles, bir nechta -f?
questions.explanation: compose.override.yaml avtomatik birlashadi; -f a.yaml -f b.yaml qo'lda merge; profiles ixtiyoriy service'larni yoqadi; extends/include qayta ishlatish.

questions.question: Compose'da kod o'zgarganda qayta build: `up --build`, `watch`, bind mount?
questions.explanation: up --build image'ni qayta quradi; bind mount kodni jonli ulaydi; compose watch fayl o'zgarishini sync/rebuild qiladi.

questions.question: Bir service'ni scale qilish: `docker compose up --scale api=3` — qanday muammolar chiqadi?
questions.explanation: Host port to'qnashadi (8080:8080 faqat bittaga), container_name ishlatib bo'lmaydi; load balancing uchun oldiga reverse proxy kerak, DNS round-robin service nomida.

questions.question: Compose'ni production'da (single host) ishlatish mumkinmi? Nimalarni hal qilish kerak?
questions.explanation: Mumkin, kichik tizim uchun. Lekin HA yo'q (bitta host), rolling update yo'q, scheduling yo'q. Restart policy, healthcheck, log rotation, resurs limit, backup, secret, zero-downtime strategiyasi qo'lda.

questions.question: Compose `deploy:` bloki va `docker stack deploy` qanday bog'langan?
questions.explanation: deploy (replicas, resources, update_config, placement) asosan Swarm uchun; docker stack deploy compose faylini Swarm'da ishlatadi. Oddiy compose faqat resources va replicas'ning bir qismini hisobga oladi; build: stack'da e'tiborsiz.

questions.question: Compose asosiy buyruqlari: up, down, ps, logs, exec, run, build, pull, restart.
questions.explanation: up — yaratib ishga tushiradi; down — o'chiradi; exec — ishlab turgan service ichida; run — bir martalik yangi container; build/pull — image; restart — qayta ishga tushirish (config qayta o'qilmaydi).

questions.question: Compose'da `ports` va `expose` farqi?
questions.explanation: ports — host portini container portiga ochadi (tashqaridan kirish). expose — faqat hujjat/ichki; service'lar o'zaro baribir gaplasha oladi.

questions.question: Compose'da `build:` va `image:` birga ishlatilsa nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: build image'ni quradi va image: nomini tag sifatida beradi. Faqat image: bo'lsa — registry'dan pull.

questions.question: Compose'da resurs limitlari va log rotation qanday beriladi?
questions.explanation: deploy.resources.limits (cpus, memory) — compose v2 standalone'da ham qo'llanadi. logging: driver + options max-size/max-file.

questions.question: Compose'da bir nechta network bilan izolyatsiya: frontend/backend.
questions.explanation: Har service faqat kerakli network'ga ulanadi; db faqat backend'da bo'lsa web undan ko'rinmaydi. internal: true — tashqi internetga chiqishsiz.

questions.question: Compose secrets qanday ishlatiladi va env'dan nimasi yaxshi?
questions.explanation: secrets: faylni container'ga /run/secrets/<name> sifatida mount qiladi. Env docker inspect, /proc/<pid>/environ, crash log va child process'larda ko'rinadi.

questions.question: Compose bilan CI'da integration test qanday yuritiladi?
questions.explanation: compose bilan DB/Redis/Kafka ko'tariladi, healthy bo'lishini kutib, test service run qilinadi, oxirida down -v. --exit-code-from va unikal project nomi.

questions.question: Compose loyihasi nomi (project name) nima va u nimaga ta'sir qiladi?
questions.explanation: Default — papka nomi. Container, network, volume nomlari prefix oladi (<project>_db_1, <project>_pgdata). Papka nomi o'zgarsa yangi volume yaratiladi — eski ma'lumot "yo'qolgandek" ko'rinadi.

questions.question: Compose bilan zero-downtime deploy qanday qilasan?
questions.explanation: Compose up -d container'ni recreate qiladi — qisqa uzilish. Yechim: reverse proxy (Traefik/nginx) + scale 2 va navbat bilan almashtirish, yoki blue/green ikki service.

questions.question: Server reboot bo'ldi — Compose bilan ishlagan servislar ko'tarilmadi. Nega va qanday tuzatasan?
questions.explanation: Compose o'zi daemon emas; restart policy bo'lmasa container reboot'dan keyin turmaydi. `restart: unless-stopped` va docker.service enabled bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: `docker compose up -d` dan keyin `WARN Found orphan containers` va eski service hali ishlayapti, port band. Nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: compose.yaml'dan service o'chirilgan yoki nomi o'zgargan — eski container project label bilan qolgan. `docker compose up -d --remove-orphans`. Avval nimani o'chirayotganingni ko'r.

questions.question: Compose'da `db` healthy, lekin `api` start bo'lishi bilan `connection refused` beradi va yiqiladi. Qanday hal qilasan?
questions.explanation: depends_on default faqat start tartibi. `condition: service_healthy` + db'da to'g'ri healthcheck (pg_isready). Plus app ichida retry — prod'da DB qayta ishga tushishi mumkin.

questions.question: Compose bilan prod serverda `docker compose pull && up -d` qilindi — 20-30 soniya sayt ochilmadi. Qanday qisqartirasan?
questions.explanation: up -d container'ni stop → yangi start qiladi; start + warm-up vaqtida downtime. Yechim: oldin pull, healthcheck, reverse proxy (Traefik/nginx) orqali 2 replica navbatma-navbat yoki docker-rollout; jiddiy bo'lsa Swarm/K8s.

questions.question: Compose'dagi Postgres volume'i noto'g'ri `down -v` bilan o'chdi. Nima qilasan va keyin qanday oldini olasan?
questions.explanation: Tiklash faqat backup'dan (pg_dump/WAL arxiv). Oldini olish: external volume, alohida backup (pg_dump cron yoki pgBackRest offsite), restore testi, prod'da qo'lda `-v` ishlatmaslik.

questions.question: Compose'da volume e'lon qilish: named volume va bind mount yozilishi qanday farq qiladi?
questions.explanation: Named volume: `db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data` + yuqori darajadagi `volumes:` bo'limi; Docker boshqaradi. Bind mount: `./src:/app` — host yo'li, dev uchun.

questions.question: `docker compose run` va `docker compose exec` farqi?
questions.explanation: `exec` ishlab turgan container ichida buyruq bajaradi. `run` yangi bir martalik container yaratadi (portlar default ochilmaydi), migratsiya yoki skript uchun.

questions.question: Compose fayl nomi: `docker-compose.yml` va `compose.yaml`, `docker-compose` va `docker compose` farqi?
questions.explanation: `compose.yaml` hozirgi tavsiya etilgan nom (eski nom ham o'qiladi). `docker-compose` — eski Python v1 (EOL), `docker compose` — Go'da yozilgan v2 CLI plugin.

questions.question: Compose'da `restart` policy'lari va `healthcheck` qanday ishlaydi? Unhealthy container qayta ishga tushadimi?
questions.explanation: `restart: unless-stopped`/`always`/`on-failure` faqat process exit'ga reaksiya qiladi. healthcheck status beradi va `depends_on: service_healthy` uchun ishlatiladi, lekin unhealthy'da restart yo'q.

questions.question: Compose'da `extends`, YAML anchor (`x-` extension) va `include` — takrorni qanday kamaytirasiz?
questions.explanation: `x-*` + YAML anchor bitta fayl ichida umumiy blok uchun; `extends` boshqa service/fayldan meros; `include` (Compose 2.20+) boshqa compose loyihasini butunicha qo'shadi.

questions.question: `docker compose config` nima uchun kerak va CI'da qanday foydalanasiz?
questions.explanation: Barcha fayllar, override, .env interpolatsiya va profile'lardan keyingi yakuniy modelni chiqaradi va validatsiya qiladi. CI'da sintaksis/interpolatsiya xatosini deploy'dan oldin ushlaydi.

questions.question: Compose'da `env_file` va `--env-file` farqi?
questions.explanation: `env_file:` service ichidagi container env'iga o'zgaruvchi beradi. `--env-file` (va loyihaning `.env`) esa compose.yaml'ni interpolatsiya qilish uchun — container'ga avtomatik o'tmaydi.

questions.question: Compose'da GPU va device'larni container'ga qanday berasiz?
questions.explanation: `deploy.resources.reservations.devices` (driver: nvidia, capabilities: [gpu]) — NVIDIA Container Toolkit kerak. Oddiy device uchun `devices: - /dev/ttyUSB0`.

questions.question: Compose stack'ni bitta VM'da prod'da ishlatyapsiz. Deploy paytida downtime va rollback'ni qanday hal qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Image'ni tag/digest bilan pin, `pull` avval, reverse proxy (Traefik/Caddy) orqasida ikki nusxa (blue/green yoki scale 2 → yangi → eski o'chir), healthcheck, rollback = oldingi tag bilan `up -d`.

questions.question: Compose'da DB'ni backup qilish va restore'ni test qilish qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Volume'ni ishlab turgan DB'dan nusxalash emas — mantiqiy dump (pg_dump) yoki DB'ning o'z backup vositasi; off-host saqlash; restore'ni muntazam alohida container'da test qilish.

questions.question: Compose loyihasida service'lar sonini va resurslarni qanday cheklaysiz, bitta servis butun host'ni o'ldirmasligi uchun?
questions.explanation: Har service'ga `mem_limit`/`cpus` (yoki `deploy.resources.limits`), `pids_limit`, log rotation, `ulimits`, restart backoff. Host'ga OS va dockerd uchun zaxira qoldirish.

questions.question: Jamoangiz lokal dev uchun Compose ishlatadi, prod esa K8s. Dev/prod parity'ni qanday saqlaysiz?
questions.explanation: Bitta image (bir xil Dockerfile/digest) dev va prod'da; config faqat env orqali (12-factor); Compose'ni manba deb emas, dev qulayligi deb ko'rish; integration testlar CI'da prod'ga yaqin muhitda (kind/k3d) ham.

questions.question: Compose'da yozilgan 15 servisli tizim o'smoqda. Qachon va qanday Compose'dan orchestrator'ga o'tasiz?
questions.explanation: Signallar: bir host yetmaydi, HA kerak (host o'limi = outage), zero-downtime deploy qo'lda skript bo'lib ketgan, ko'p jamoa. Bosqichma-bosqich: avval stateless servislar, state managed servisga.

questions.question: Oddiy `compose.yaml` ning asosiy tuzilishi?
questions.explanation: Yuqori darajadagi `services`, `volumes`, `networks`. Har service — image yoki build, ports, env, volumes.

questions.question: `docker compose up -d` nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Fayldagi barcha service'larni (kerak bo'lsa build/pull qilib) fon rejimida ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: `depends_on` nima kafolatlaydi?
questions.explanation: Faqat ishga tushish tartibini. Dependency "tayyor" bo'lishini emas — buning uchun `condition: service_healthy`.

questions.question: Compose'da environment o'zgaruvchilarini berish usullari?
questions.explanation: `environment:`, `env_file:`, va loyiha papkasidagi `.env` (fayl ichidagi `${VAR}` uchun).

questions.question: `docker compose config` nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: Barcha fayllar, `.env` va o'zgaruvchilar birlashgan yakuniy konfiguratsiyani ko'rsatadi va sintaksisni tekshiradi.

questions.question: Bir nechta compose faylni birlashtirish (override)?
questions.explanation: `compose.override.yaml` avtomatik qo'shiladi; boshqalari `-f` bilan, keyingisi oldingisini ustidan yozadi.

questions.question: Compose'da service'ni scale qilish?
questions.explanation: `docker compose up -d --scale web=3`. Bunda qat'iy host port (`8080:8080`) to'qnashadi.

questions.question: Compose loyiha nomi (project name) nima?
questions.explanation: Konteyner, network, volume nomlariga prefiks. Default — papka nomi; `-p` yoki `name:` bilan o'zgartiriladi.

questions.question: Compose default network qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Har loyiha uchun `<project>_default` network yaratiladi; service'lar bir-birini service nomi bilan topadi.

questions.question: Compose'da `restart:` qiymatlari?
questions.explanation: `no`, `always`, `on-failure`, `unless-stopped` — Docker restart policy bilan bir xil.

questions.question: Compose'da loglarni qanday ko'rasiz?
questions.explanation: `docker compose logs` — barcha service'lar, rang bilan ajratilgan.

questions.question: `docker compose stop`, `down`, `rm` farqi?
questions.explanation: stop — to'xtatadi, konteyner qoladi. down — konteyner va network'ni o'chiradi. rm — to'xtagan konteynerlarni o'chiradi.

questions.question: Compose'da image'larni qanday yangilaysiz?
questions.explanation: `docker compose pull` keyin `docker compose up -d` — o'zgargan service'lar qayta yaratiladi.

questions.question: Compose'da healthcheck qanday yoziladi?
questions.explanation: Service ichida `healthcheck:` bloki: `test`, `interval`, `timeout`, `retries`, `start_period`.

questions.question: Compose'da resurs limitlari?
questions.explanation: `deploy.resources.limits` (yoki `mem_limit`, `cpus`).

questions.question: Dev muhitda kodni konteynerga jonli ulash?
questions.explanation: Bind mount: `./src:/app/src` — kod o'zgarishi darhol konteynerda ko'rinadi.

questions.question: Compose'da secret'lar qanday beriladi?
questions.explanation: Top-level `secrets:` (fayldan) — konteynerda `/run/secrets/<nom>` fayli bo'lib ko'rinadi.

questions.question: `docker compose ps` nima ko'rsatadi?
questions.explanation: Loyiha service'lari konteynerlari, holati (running, exited, healthy) va portlari.

questions.question: Compose'da `command` va `entrypoint` ni almashtirish?
questions.explanation: `command:` — Dockerfile CMD o'rniga, `entrypoint:` — ENTRYPOINT o'rniga.

questions.question: Compose'da profillar (`profiles`) nima?
questions.explanation: Ba'zi service'larni faqat kerak bo'lganda yoqish (masalan debug vositalari).

questions.question: Compose'da `.env` fayli qayerdan o'qiladi?
questions.explanation: Loyiha papkasidan (compose fayl yonida) avtomatik; `--env-file` bilan boshqasini berish mumkin.

questions.question: Compose'da named volume va bind mount qachon ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Named volume — DB kabi doimiy ma'lumot (Docker boshqaradi). Bind mount — host faylini ulash (kod, config).

questions.question: `docker compose exec db psql -U postgres` nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Ishlab turgan `db` konteyneri ichida `psql` ni ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: Compose'da port faqat localhost'ga qanday ochiladi?
questions.explanation: `"127.0.0.1:5432:5432"` — tashqaridan kirib bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Compose'da `build` bo'limi parametrlari?
questions.explanation: `context`, `dockerfile`, `args`, `target` (multi-stage).

questions.question: Compose bilan bir martalik vazifa (migratsiya) ishga tushirish?
questions.explanation: `docker compose run --rm <service> <buyruq>`.

questions.question: Compose qachon yetarli va qachon Kubernetes/Swarm kerak?
questions.explanation: Compose — bitta host, dev/test, kichik prod. Ko'p host, HA, auto-heal kerak bo'lsa — orchestrator.

questions.question: `docker compose top` va `stats` nima ko'rsatadi?
questions.explanation: `top` — har konteyner ichidagi jarayonlar. `docker stats` — CPU/RAM/tarmoq real vaqtda.

questions.question: Compose'da `networks` bilan service'larni ajratish?
questions.explanation: Frontend va backend network'lar — masalan proxy faqat API'ni ko'rsin, DB'ni emas.

questions.question: Compose'da `extends` yoki YAML anchor nima uchun?
questions.explanation: Takrorlanadigan konfiguratsiyani bir joyda yozish.

questions.question: Compose'da log rotate qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: Service'da `logging:` — driver va `max-size`, `max-file`.

questions.question: `docker compose restart` va `up -d --force-recreate` farqi?
questions.explanation: restart — o'sha konteynerni qayta ishga tushiradi (yangi config qo'llanmaydi). force-recreate — konteynerni yangidan yaratadi.

questions.question: Compose bilan prod'ga deploy qilishda nimalarga e'tibor?
questions.explanation: Aniq image tag, restart policy, healthcheck, log rotate, secret'lar, resurs limit, localhost'ga bog'langan DB porti, backup.

questions.question: Compose'da ishlayotgan konteynerda o'zgaruvchini tekshirish?
questions.explanation: `docker compose exec api env` yoki `docker compose config`.

questions.question: Compose'da `init: true` nima?
questions.explanation: Konteynerga kichik init (tini) qo'shadi — signal'larni to'g'ri uzatadi va zombie'larni yig'adi.

questions.question: Compose'da `stop_grace_period` nima?
questions.explanation: `down`/`stop` da SIGTERM'dan keyin SIGKILL'gacha kutish vaqti (default 10s).

questions.question: Compose'da `tmpfs` qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Konteynerda RAM'dagi vaqtinchalik papka — tez va diskka yozilmaydi.

questions.question: Compose'da `docker compose events` nima?
questions.explanation: Konteyner voqealarini (start, die, health) real vaqtda ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: Compose'da image'ni registry'ga push qilish?
questions.explanation: Service'da `image:` va `build:` bo'lsa, `docker compose build` keyin `docker compose push`.

questions.question: Compose'da `ports` qisqa va uzun sintaksisi?
questions.explanation: Qisqa: `"8080:80"`. Uzun: `target`, `published`, `protocol`, `host_ip`.

questions.question: Compose'da `docker compose ls` nima?
questions.explanation: Hostdagi barcha Compose loyihalari va holatini ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: Compose faylida versiya (`version: "3.8"`) kerakmi?
questions.explanation: Yo'q — Compose v2 (Compose Specification) uni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, ogohlantirish beradi.
